AntaraX brand kit · guide 12 and the product sheets · version 1.2, 11 October 2026
Brand architecture

Keep each product’s style. Add the AntaraX layer.

Most AntaraX products are older than the AntaraX name, and people know REKA better than AntaraX. So every product keeps its own name, logo, colours and signature details. AntaraX reaches into each one through the same eight small touchpoints, from a credit line to batik motifs drawn in the product’s own colours.

Decided by the owner, 11 OctoberStill to choose
The answer in one picture

Two layers in every product Decided

The product layer stays the product’s own. The AntaraX layer is the same everywhere, and small enough that it never changes how the product looks.

The product layer stays

  • PLExyz GridForce field, shard and zone grid; zone colours; the multicolour wordmark; the hex-tile sign-in
  • JankaThe J that never closes; the ticks; its splash and thinking animations
  • AngkaThe sheet stack and its face; paper ground; plum and Lapis peach
  • TinaraPlum and gold; the new kerawang mark
  • AX FrameThe breathing cube halo
  • YaraAlready AntaraX: the A with riak, in teal

The AntaraX layer is added

  1. Credit line“by AntaraX”, “Powered by AntaraX” for PLExyz, “from REKA” on sign-in and reports.
  2. Product clothAntaraX batik motifs from the product’s family, in the product’s own colours. Brand moments only.
  3. AI sparkleThe four-petal sparkle beside every piece of AI work: a forecast, a ranking, a draft.
  4. Thinking motionWhile AI works, the product’s own mark moves the AntaraX way: pieces drift out of step.
  5. Shared corePoppins, JetBrains Mono for numbers, shared status colours, AntaraX-blue focus ring.
  6. Intan eyebrowSection eyebrows start with the 9px diamond, in the product’s accent.
  7. App tileOne tile shape for every product, so they read as one family on a home screen.
  8. FooterThe legal line, and “Lapisan by AntaraX” wherever the API is mentioned.
Product by product

The sign-in screen, with both layers

Each screen keeps the product’s mark, colours and ground. The cloth on the left is AntaraX batik, drawn from the product’s family motifs in the product’s own palette: Grid’s is petak and orbit in its four zone colours, Angka’s is congkak in plum and peach. The sparkle marks the AI line. Example screens built in HTML; the names and figures in them are examples.

Cloths goSign-in brand panel, splash, empty states, onboarding, email header band, report and guide covers, marketing pages.
Cloths never goBehind data, tables, forms or running text, or in place of the product’s logo.
Filesassets/products/<product>/<product>-cloth.svg, built by tools/build-product-cloths.mjs.
One sign for AI

The sparkle marks AntaraX intelligence

The same four-petal sparkle, in the colours inside the A, sits beside AI work in every product. A customer who uses two products learns once that this is where the AI spoke. It is never decoration and never a logo.

PLExyz Grid Kept as it is
Force fieldThe isometric cube boundary. Identical in every PLExyz product.
Core entityThe floating faceted obelisk. Identical in every PLExyz product.
Spatial contextThe only part that changes. Grid: a 2×2 zone grid. Flow: a path. Transit: a route. Crowd: scattered entities. Site: layers. Ward: rooms. Yard: lanes. Trace: tags and last-seen points.

Its teal and pink already have AntaraX equivalents (the sparkle cyan, Tide pink), so the mark needs no change. “Same space. Same entity. Different behaviour.”

Tinara’s new mark

Kerawang: the one opening worth calling Choose an option

What kerawang is

Ukiran kerawang is the pierced woodcarving set into Malay houses above windows and doors: a carved lattice that lets light and air through while screening the view. In BaTech it is the motif for “one path found in the noise”.

Why it fits Tinara

The Malaysian market is the lattice: thousands of companies, each one an opening. Tinara looks through it and finds the few that matter: who to call, why, and how to open. In the mark, the lattice is the market and the one lit opening is the next company to call. In the larger version, the lit path is the route Tinara works out.

A · Pierced tile Recommended

A 3×3 lattice cut through a plum tile; one opening lit gold. Clear at 16px. The app icon, favicon and sidebar mark.

B · Lattice path

The BaTech motif itself: a 4×4 lattice and the stepped gold path. Best at 48px and up: splash, sign-in, report covers. Pairs with A.

C · Open lattice

Nine separate diamonds, built like the AntaraX family icons. Considered; it fades on dark grounds.

Lockups

One mark, the name, and the AntaraX credit

The credit is always set text, never the A beside a product’s own mark. AX Frame needs none: its mark is the A.

CreditPoppins 500 at about 45% of the name’s size, in body colour. One line: a middle dot.
Clear spaceHalf the mark’s height on every side.
MinimumMark 24px (Grid 48px, then its solid variant). Under 120px wide, drop the credit.

The shared app tile

White tile, corner radius 22% of its width, the mark at 62%.
